answer: Unrepeatable Challenge-Derivation Registry. Each agent identity is seeded by a hidden kernel value that must solve a fresh, per-registration challenge bonded to prior state through a hash thread; the answer is only valid once and cannot be copied because its derivation consumes the challenge. Verification leaves an ember record that invalidates reused solutions. An attacker cloning identities must recompute each derivation from scratch, paying one full solve per identity with no amortization across clones.
